summary: Approved Story 2 architecture against the approved requirements; the prior bounded finding is resolved.

findings: Architecture now makes OpenAPI response metadata mandatory for GET /api/employees/{id} 404 and POST /api/employees 400, using the existing ErrorResponse schema. This resolves the prior blocker and covers existing FR-4/AC-3; it does not introduce a new requirement.

The remaining endpoint, schema, behavior-preservation, verification, and documentation choices are consistent with the approved requirements. The springdoc dependency choice is reasoned for the stated Spring Boot version; dependency resolution and runtime compatibility remain unverified.
